text:
maria_procure: Vendor is asking for a customs retainer of €2.9k to fast-clear 8 H100s into FRA (AWB FR777000111). They claim ~72h release vs 10+ business days otherwise. thoughts?
kevin_ops: Breakdown? refundable vs non-refundable?
vendor_rep: Broker expedite €1.8k (non-refundable), customs deposit €1.0k (refundable after clearance), local handling €100.
maria_procure: Ops — is saving ~10 business days worth ~€1.9k net risk? This is for the EMEA dedicated ramp starting next sprint.
kevin_ops: Approve up to €3k if vendor signs PO addendum: vendor covers return shipping & replacement for any DOA discovered at depot within 7 days, and uploads full serial manifest + COI before release.
vendor_rep: Agreed to addendum terms; manifest and COI uploading now.
rma_bot: [automated] RMA ticket RMA-99881 opened for AWB FR777000111. Attach depot photos + acceptance form within 72h of handoff.
finance_team: Finance: set up escrow for refundable deposit and create PO addendum. GL code OPS-PROV-FRA. Hold wire until escrow confirmation.
maria_procure: Thanks — proceeding with PO addendum and escrow. will update when escrow is active and manifest verified.
